guidebook.intro: Buuza ebibuuzo: ki, ani, wa, di, lwaki ne kitya.

tips.title: Ekigambo ky’ekibuuzo kisooka
body: Mu Lusoga ekigambo ky’ekibuuzo kitera okudha ku nkomerero: **Ekitabo kyange kiri wa?** Mu Lungereza kisooka: **Where is my book?**

tips.title: Okuyiga okuva mu bantu
body: Ebibuuzo bino bikuyamba okuyiga ebigambo ebigya: **What is this called in English?** **How do you say “ekibo” in English?** **How do you spel it?**
Okudamu **Why?** tandika ne **Because**: **Because I want to speak with people.**

culture.title: “I speak a little”
body: Bw’ogamba **I speak a little English**, abantu batera okwogera mpola n’okukuyamba. Tewatya okukozesa Olungereza lw’omanyi.
